about:
# Arc Auras

Cooldowns, auras, resources, castbars, swing timers and reminders for retail and
WoW Forever: icons, groups and bars you place anywhere. Type `/arcauras` in game to
open it (`/arcui2` when ArcUI is installed).

- Cooldown icons, aura icons for buffs and debuffs, plus item, trinket, totem, weapon enchant and ammo icons
- Bars for cooldowns, auras, resources, health, casts, swing timers and target range
- Put things in groups or place them anywhere, and anchor them to each other or to your mouse
- Decide when each one shows up: in or out of combat, by talent, and more
- Style a whole layout at once, or tweak each piece on its own
- Export and import a single icon, a group or a whole layout
- A live preview while you edit

Arc UI Forever is now Arc Auras: install it and your setup moves over by itself.
On retail, Arc Auras can import your ArcUI ProcTracker trackers.

## Download

- [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/arc-auras)
- [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/arc-auras)

## Feedback

Bugs and ideas go to the [Discord](https://discord.gg/yMZmnFjUTd).

Pull requests are welcome: fork the repo and open one against `main`.

# Arc Auras

## 3.3.7

Bar Groups that close their gaps, level and zone load rules, and a move mode that shows every item.

### New Features

- **Bar Groups** - Add > Group > Bar Group puts your bars in a line that closes the gaps as they come and go: cooldown, timer, totem and swing bars, in combat too. Grow down, up, left or right, lying or standing bars, with the same Dynamic options as icon groups.
- **Level and Zone load rules** - Load Conditions can now limit an item to a range of levels, and to zones you list or away from them. Add current zone picks where you stand.

### Improvements

- **Move layouts** - Right-clicking the minimap button now shows every icon and bar in its spot inside a box that wraps the whole layout, even ones that are hidden right now.

## 3.3.6

Count text for reagents and items, time left colors on stack bars, and a new look for the bar Effects tab.

### New Features

- **Count text** - A spell icon can show a count: how many casts its reagents allow, or any item by its ID. Text > Stacks > Count text.
- **Time left on stack bars** - An aura stack bar can also color by time left: a time step it is under wins over the stack colors, so low stacks or a running-out buff both show.

### Improvements

- **Bar Effects tab** - Works like the icon Effects tab: each trigger in the list shows a small picture of how it paints the bar, its effects sit on tabs with + Add effect, and on an aura stack bar arrows pick whether Time left or Stacks wins.
- **Red remove buttons** - Remove trigger and the other remove buttons on both Effects tabs are red, so they stand apart.
- **Gain in percent** - Find upgrades and item tooltips can show a gain as a percent of the piece you wear; no simulator needed. Turn it on for tooltips under Gear value in tooltips.
- **Fonts** - Fonts from media addons and the options window's own font load more reliably on the first login after starting the game.

### Bug Fixes

- **Bar editor** - A thin blue strip no longer stays on other tabs after picking a trigger on Effects.
- **Find upgrades** - Lists every upgrade on the auction house: gear read early in a big search, or valued on a scale ticked afterwards, was left out. A single slot also searches in a second or two.
- **Minimap button** - Minimap addons now list, place and fade the Arc Auras button like the others, and it stays on a square minimap after a reload.
- **Minimap button drag** - The minimap button drags again without an error.

## 3.3.5

More triggers for the aura on a cooldown icon, its cooldown text over the aura, swipe and border effects, gear goals and upgrades from the auction house.

### New Features

- **Aura missing on cooldown icons** - A spell, item or trinket icon with an aura on it can fade, tint, glow or play a sound while that aura is missing, so a spell can glow while your target lacks your debuff.
- **Aura sounds on cooldown icons** - The aura on a cooldown icon can play a sound when it appears, gains a stack or drops.
- **Swipe and Border effects** - Effects > + Add effect can change an aura's swipe and its border color while the aura is up, on aura icons and cooldown icons.
- **Four glows** - The aura on a cooldown icon has four glows, as an aura icon does.
- **Cooldown text over the aura** - A cooldown icon with an aura on it can show its cooldown's number at a spot of its own, over the aura too, so the aura's time and the cooldown show at once.
- **Charges at their own spot** - A charge spell with an aura on it can show its charges apart from the aura's stack count.
- **Gear goals** - Each Gear Value scale can carry goals (critical strike, haste, mastery, versatility): set what your gear should give, see how close your worn gear is, and the stat stops counting once you reach it. Goals travel with the scale's export, and tooltips can show them.
- **Effects and set bonuses** - A Gear Value scale can count an item's special effect or a set bonus: add the item or the set, then type its value or let it be read.
- **Find upgrades** - With Gear Value on, the auction house gets a Find Upgrades tab: pick your scales and slots, and it lists only the gear that beats what you wear, best first, by points, DPS or DPS %.

### Improvements

- **Gear Value page** - Pick at the top which scales your tooltips show; below it, a scale editor with Weights, Goals and Extras tabs beside the preview.
- **Gear Value import** - Paste one or more weights strings at once; a scale with the same name is updated in place, goals included.

## 3.3.4

Pick which aura an icon shows when several are up, and a trigger for each aura.

### New Features

- **When several are up** - An icon that lists several auras can pick which one shows while more than one is up: the first one up, the newest, by time left, or in list order, where the first aura listed always wins.
- **A trigger for each aura** - In list order, Effects > + Add a trigger also offers a trigger for each listed aura, each with its own glow.

## 3.3.3

A count of your totems out, aura tooltips, rounding per group, more ring thicknesses and Arc UI import fixes.

### New Features

- **Totems out** - A totem icon or totem bar set to Which one: Any shows how many of its totems are out. Icons can change their look at a count, and bars can color by it under Effects > Stacks.

### Improvements

- **Aura tooltips** - Aura icons and Aura Groups show the aura's own tooltip on hover, Close gaps included. It follows your Show tooltip setting.
- **Show tooltip** - Now on an icon's Tracking tab and a group's Appearance > Icons, so one group or icon can show tooltips, hide them, or show them only while the options window is open.
- **Round timer numbers per group** - A group can round its icons' timers up or down (Appearance > Icons > Timers). An icon can still pick its own.
- **Ring thickness** - Rings come in seven thicknesses, from Extra thin to Thick.
- **Only on-use trinkets** - A passive trinket now dims while the options window is open, so you can see the option take effect.

### Bug Fixes

- **Arc UI import** - Buffs watched on you and your target import as buffs, and custom tick values carry over on every bar.
- **Defaults page** - A font set there now reaches icons brought in from Arc UI, and Change them too now also changes icons and bars that hold their own value for that row, such as a keybind size.
- **Texture timers** - A texture's countdown follows a new rounding right away.
- **Fonts** - A font from another addon now shows on every icon and bar, even when it loads late.
- **Missing glows** - A glow shown while the aura is missing now has its own Strata and Level, so it can sit above other frames.
- **Aura over a spell** - A spell icon that shows an aura no longer blinks out for a moment when it comes off cooldown or the aura procs.

## 3.3.2

Gear Value module, simpler totem tracking and a fix for the While freeze on bars.

### New Features

- **Gear Value** - A new module: gear tooltips show what an item is worth to stat weights you set, against what you wear. Set your own weights or paste a weights string from a simulator, and pick which scales show for each spec. Turn it on in Modules > Gear Value.

### Improvements

- **Follow the newest** - Totem icons, totem bars and aura icons that show their totem can move to the newest one when you cast again, as the Cooldown Manager does. It replaces Cooldown Manager sync, and icons set to it follow the newest.
- **Totem options on aura icons** - An aura icon set to show its totem first now has Which one, Counted by, Several from one cast and Wait for its slot.
- **Skip these items** - A trinket icon can skip trinkets by item ID: while one of them is worn in its slot, the icon hides.
- **Bar Effects tab** - A tidier While page and trigger list, and the state table on power bars sits in its own box.

### Bug Fixes

- **Fonts** - A font from another addon now shows on every icon and bar, even when it loads late.
- **Missing glows** - A glow shown while the aura is missing now has its own Strata and Level, so it can sit above other frames.
- **Aura over a spell** - A spell icon that shows an aura no longer blinks out for a moment when it comes off cooldown or the aura procs.

Gear Value module, simpler totem tracking and a fix for the While freeze on bars.

- **Totem tracking** - A summon keeps its timer when you cast another spell, and totem bars follow a summon whose time is extended, such as Dreadstalkers with Summon Demonic Tyrant.
- **Effects: While** - Opening While on a bar, or ticking one of its conditions, no longer freezes the game.

## 3.3.6

Count text for reagents and items, time left colors on stack bars, and a new look for the bar Effects tab.

### New Features

- **Count text** - A spell icon can show a count: how many casts its reagents allow, or any item by its ID. Text > Stacks > Count text.
- **Time left on stack bars** - An aura stack bar can also color by time left: a time step it is under wins over the stack colors, so low stacks or a running-out buff both show.

### Improvements

- **Bar Effects tab** - Works like the icon Effects tab: each trigger in the list shows a small picture of how it paints the bar, its effects sit on tabs with + Add effect, and on an aura stack bar arrows pick whether Time left or Stacks wins.
- **Red remove buttons** - Remove trigger and the other remove buttons on both Effects tabs are red, so they stand apart.
- **Gain in percent** - Find upgrades and item tooltips can show a gain as a percent of the piece you wear; no simulator needed. Turn it on for tooltips under Gear value in tooltips.

### Bug Fixes

- **Bar editor** - A thin blue strip no longer stays on other tabs after picking a trigger on Effects.
- **Find upgrades** - Lists every upgrade on the auction house: gear read early in a big search, or valued on a scale ticked afterwards, was left out. A single slot also searches in a second or two.

## 3.3.5

More triggers for the aura on a cooldown icon, its cooldown text over the aura, swipe and border effects, gear goals and upgrades from the auction house.

### New Features

- **Aura missing on cooldown icons** - A spell, item or trinket icon with an aura on it can fade, tint, glow or play a sound while that aura is missing, so a spell can glow while your target lacks your debuff.
- **Aura sounds on cooldown icons** - The aura on a cooldown icon can play a sound when it appears, gains a stack or drops.
- **Swipe and Border effects** - Effects > + Add effect can change an aura's swipe and its border color while the aura is up, on aura icons and cooldown icons.
- **Four glows** - The aura on a cooldown icon has four glows, as an aura icon does.
- **Cooldown text over the aura** - A cooldown icon with an aura on it can show its cooldown's number at a spot of its own, over the aura too, so the aura's time and the cooldown show at once.
- **Charges at their own spot** - A charge spell with an aura on it can show its charges apart from the aura's stack count.
- **Gear goals** - Each Gear Value scale can carry goals (critical strike, haste, mastery, versatility): set what your gear should give, see how close your worn gear is, and the stat stops counting once you reach it. Goals travel with the scale's export, and tooltips can show them.
- **Effects and set bonuses** - A Gear Value scale can count an item's special effect or a set bonus: add the item or the set, then type its value or let it be read.
- **Find upgrades** - With Gear Value on, the auction house gets a Find Upgrades tab: pick your scales and slots, and it lists only the gear that beats what you wear, best first, by points, DPS or DPS %.

### Improvements

- **Gear Value page** - Pick at the top which scales your tooltips show; below it, a scale editor with Weights, Goals and Extras tabs beside the preview.
- **Gear Value import** - Paste one or more weights strings at once; a scale with the same name is updated in place, goals included.

## 3.3.4

Pick which aura an icon shows when several are up, and a trigger for each aura.

### New Features

- **When several are up** - An icon that lists several auras can pick which one shows while more than one is up: the first one up, the newest, by time left, or in list order, where the first aura listed always wins.
- **A trigger for each aura** - In list order, Effects > + Add a trigger also offers a trigger for each listed aura, each with its own glow.
